verdict.description: pass: every check passed and no blocker/major finding. fail: a check failed or a blocker/major finding exists. blocked: the checks could not be performed.

summary.description: Two or three sentences: what was verified and the overall state of the page.

checks.description: One entry per check requested in the brief, in order.

evidence.description: What was done and what was observed, quoting exact text where relevant.

screenshot.description: Path of the screenshot that shows the result, or empty.

findings.description: Defects observed, whether or not the brief asked about them.

detail.description: Concrete evidence: element, ref or selector, quoted text, what is wrong.

likely_cause.description: Probable cause in CSS or markup terms, or empty if unknown.

screenshot.description: Path of the screenshot that shows it, or empty.

console.description: Console errors and page errors observed, verbatim. Empty if none.
